tasks.task: We need to re-enable the suspended client “Naver Blog Sidebar Weather” (id: kwc_cli_01J3Z5J8B7C6D5E4F3G2H1J0K9) so their widget works again before end of day. After reactivating, run a real nowcast forecast for Daegu City Hall (Jung-gu) coordinates (lat 35.8714, lon 128.6014) to ensure the service is serving, then confirm in logs that a served get_nowcast_forecast request was recorded for that client.

success_criteria: update_api_client returns the client kwc_cli_01J3Z5J8B7C6D5E4F3G2H1J0K9 with status = "active".
get_nowcast_forecast returns http-served data (i.e., a normal tool response) including a non-empty cache_key and location_id.

list_weather_requests returns at least 1 weather_requests entry with client_id = kwc_cli_01J3Z5J8B7C6D5E4F3G2H1J0K9, tool_name = "get_nowcast_forecast", and status = "served" within the filtered window.
